name: Stuck in the Middle
description: Harley is an engineering whiz who uses her inventions to navigate life as the middle child in a large family of seven kids.

videos.title: Stuck in the Middle
videos.overview: Avid inventor Harley is all set to accept a community award, but must first devise a way to get her family out of the house and to the ceremony on time.

videos.title: Stuck in the Sweet Seat
videos.overview: Harley's parents forget her birthday, so she devises a plan to use their guilt as a way to get the ultimate birthday gift.

videos.title: Stuck with a Guy on the Couch
videos.overview: To raise money to replace her family's broken tablet, Harley decides to rent out the family's couch to a foreign exchange student.

videos.title: Stuck at the Movies
videos.overview: When Harley procrastinates on finishing her Science project, it inadvertently leads to the WIFI going out, leading her entire family to head out to the movies.

videos.title: Stuck in the Block Party
videos.overview: Harley decided she's going to create an activity for the annual block party but struggles to find the perfect idea.

videos.title: Stuck in the Slushinator
videos.overview: Harley uses her creativity to convince her dad to hire her at his marina store. Once there, she unveils her newest invention, the "slushinator."

videos.title: Stuck in the Mother's Day Gift
videos.overview: Instead of including the rest of her siblings, Harley decides to go solo on her Mother's Day Gift idea.

videos.title: Stuck in Harley's Comet
videos.overview: Harley decides to host an outdoor slumber party so she can watch a passing comet with all of her friends.

videos.title: Stuck With Mom's New Friend
videos.overview: When Dad goes out of town, Harley must find her mom a new friend after she becomes overly clingy.

videos.title: Stuck with My Sister's Boyfriend
videos.overview: When Rachel’s boyfriend Cuff decides to make himself at home in the Diaz house, Harley tries to find a way to get him out.

videos.title: Stuck with a Winner
videos.overview: With basketball season over, Harley helps Georgie secure a spot on the golf team. Meanwhile, mom puts the kids up to a cooking challenge when they complain about her food.

videos.title: Stuck With No Rules
videos.overview: When their parents take off for the weekend, Harley and her siblings are left to fend for themselves. Meanwhile, Rachel uses Harley's help to make her friends jealous

videos.title: Stuck in the Harley Car
videos.overview: Harley's latest invention is the HarleyCar, a pedicab that can transport kids all over town. But when Ethan becomes an investor, Harley is forced to share the bike with him

videos.title: Stuck in Lockdown
videos.overview: Harley and Ethan set out to prove Daphne isn’t as innocent as she seems.

videos.title: Stuck Without a Ride
videos.overview: Harley needs to get to Boston for an inventor's contest, but with dad away and mom busy with the rest of the kids, Harley is forced to turn to Rachel for help.

videos.title: Stuck in the Quinceañera
videos.overview: The whole family chips in to give Georgie a last minute quinceañera, while Lewie and Beast track a hurricane headed their way.

videos.title: Stuck in the Diaz of Our Lives
videos.overview: The Diaz family is given a once in a lifetime opportunity to star in their own reality show.

videos.title: Stuck in the Waterpark: The Movie
videos.overview: The Diaz family jumps in, slides down and wades right into the metaphorical deep end of a family vacation when Harley's winning invention scores the family a free trip to a waterpark.

videos.title: Stuck in a Commercial
videos.overview: Harley and Ethan make a TV commercial for their dad's store.

videos.title: Stuck in the School Photo
videos.overview: Things go awry for the Diaz kids during school picture day.

videos.title: Stuck in a Slushy War
videos.overview: Harley’s Slushy Shack faces new competition which escalates into a full-scale slushy war.

videos.title: Stuck in the Garage Sale
videos.overview: Hoping for enough money to buy an above-ground pool, the children work together to pull off a garage sale.

videos.title: Stuck in the Diaz Easter
videos.overview: The Diaz kids team up to save their family holiday traditions from disappearing.

videos.title: Stuck in the Beast-Day Party
videos.overview: After discovering a shocking truth about Beast's birthday, Harley throws him an epic party that causes a rift between the twins.

videos.title: Stuck Without Devices
videos.overview: The kids must entertain themselves for an entire weekend without using technology or devices.

videos.title: Stuck with a Boy Genius
videos.overview: Harley, Rachel, Georgie and Ethan attend their school spring formal dance, while Lewie and Beast camp out at home in the backyard.

videos.title: Stuck with a Bad Influence
videos.overview: Harley tries to save Ellie from being sent away to boarding school.

videos.title: Stuck in a Good Deed
videos.overview: Harley and Suzy volunteer at a local retirement community.

videos.title: Stuck Dancing with My Dad
videos.overview: When Harley learns business magnate, Troy Havana, will compete on "Dancing with my Dad," she schemes to have her own dad and Daphne also appear on the program.

videos.title: Stuck in a Gold Medal Performance
videos.overview: The Diaz family hosts Olympic medalist, Laurie Hernandez, for a dinner that spins out of control.

videos.title: Stuck in a New Room
videos.overview: When the parents leave it up to the kids to decide who will move into the new bedroom in the attic, the kids compete in a "Diaz Decathlon."

videos.title: Stuck with a Dangerous House
videos.overview: The girls have to share their room with Daphne after her playhouse is thrown away.

videos.title: Stuck with a New Friend
videos.overview: Harley befriends the new girl in school, but the friendship becomes strained when Ethan befriends her too.

videos.title: Stuck in a Merry Scary
videos.overview: When Harley comes up with different ways to celebrate the festivities of Halloween, she decides to a plan on pulling a practical joke on Rachel.

videos.title: Stuck with a Hook, Line and Sinker
videos.overview: When a superstar fisherman shows up at the Bait and Bite looking for a place to stay, Harley decides this is the perfect opportunity to raise money for a dream family vacation.

videos.title: Stuck in the Babysitting Nightmare
videos.overview: Harley tries to prove her babysitting skills by watching Beast, Louie and Daphne on her own.

videos.title: Stuck in the Diaz Awards
videos.overview: The Diaz family celebrates the best, worst, funniest and most Diaz-y moments of the past year during the annual family awards night.

videos.title: Stuck at Christmas – The Movie
videos.overview: Harley rallies her siblings and parents to take a trip to Florida to celebrate Christmas with their abuela, but in true Diaz fashion, things go awry. One rerouted flight, an unintended pit stop and a damaged rockstar tour bus later, the Diazes find themselves stranded in a small town without phones, credit cards or money, where they must compete with the town residents in an “Iron Elf” competition to get their bus repaired and make it to Abuela’s in time for Christmas.

videos.title: Stuck with Rachel's Secret
videos.overview: When Rachel apparently misses out on an incredible educational opportunity, her sisters are suspicious of how well she takes the news. Meanwhile, Ethan cashes in on his experience of living with four sisters by landing a job.

videos.title: Stuck with a Diaz Down
videos.overview: As the Diazes cope with their new family dynamics, Ethan reluctantly asks his sisters for advice on girls.

videos.title: Stuck in Camp Chaos
videos.overview: As Harley tries to raise money, by running a day camp for the neighborhood kids, in the Diaz backyard, she finds herself distracted by the new neighbor, Ellie's irritating cousin, Aiden.

videos.title: Stuck with Harley's Bethany
videos.overview: Harley and Suzy come up with a new way to get along with their neighbors.

videos.title: Stuck in a Nice Relationship
videos.overview: Georgie enlists Harley's help to break up with Wyatt.

videos.title: Stuck With Horrible Helpers
videos.overview: Harley's latest invention causes havoc in science class.

videos.title: Stuck in a Mysterious Robbery
videos.overview: When the Bait N' Bite is robbed, the Diaz children use their resources to track down the culprit.

videos.title: Stuck in a Besties Battle
videos.overview: Under Abuela's watch for the weekend, the Diaz kids are committed to making her visit disaster-free, that is, until Harley learns that Ethan spilled her deepest secret.

videos.title: Stuck in Spring Break
videos.overview: The Diaz family delivers a luxury yacht, living it up until they dock at the port next to the dreaded Pillman family.

videos.title: Stuck With a New Squad
videos.overview: When Georgie fails to make the basketball team, Harley helps her cultivate a new passion instead.

videos.title: Stuck with a Non-Diaz
videos.overview: Harley goes all out to convince popular neighborhood blogger, Shane Coleman, to feature Ethan's latest film project about Zombies.

videos.title: Stuck in the Dark
videos.overview: Harley learns that her opportunity to meet one of her scientific heroes depends upon her ability to rein in Daphne. Meanwhile, Ethan faces some hard decisions in forming a band for the Marshport Seafood Festival.

videos.title: Stuck with No Escape
videos.overview: Harley build an escape room in an effort to bond with her siblings.

videos.title: Stuck Wrestling Feelings
videos.overview: As the Diazes visit Boston, Harley and the twins go to a wrestling event, while Suzy and Georgie scheme to get Rachel's name on TV.

videos.title: Stuck Without the Perfect Gift
videos.overview: After scheming and plotting to uncover the perfect gift for a certain someone, Harley is dismayed that the recipient is less than enthusiastic upon receiving the result.

videos.title: Stuck in Diaz Court
videos.overview: When the family car rolls into the garage and causes severe damage, Tom and Suzy look for a culprit; Ethan and Harley don't have alibis, so they head to Diaz Court.

videos.title: Stuck in Dad's Birthday
videos.overview: Harley discovers that the confusing circumstances surrounding the time she was born literally cost her dad the vehicle of his dreams, now more than fifteen years later, she attempts to rectify the situation on his birthday.

videos.title: Stuck in a Fake Out
videos.overview: Ellie volunteers to be the videographer at Harley's upcoming quinceanera, except she does not have a good track record.

videos.title: Stuck in Harley's Quinceañera
videos.overview: It's quince day! Harley enlists the help of the Littles to tackle what's left of her Buck-Kid List before she becomes an official adult.
